intro.en: Read a short fictional news report and distinguish its main facts from the headline.

texto.en: In a short news item, use the first sentence and the time or place expressions to locate the event. Then check the details: who is affected, when a change begins and whether the text gives a reason. This report is fictional and is used only for language practice.

frases.es: La biblioteca del barrio de San Miguel ampliará su horario a partir del próximo lunes.
frases.en: The library in the San Miguel neighbourhood will extend its opening hours from next Monday.

frases.es: De lunes a jueves cerrará a las ocho de la tarde, dos horas más tarde que ahora.
frases.en: From Monday to Thursday it will close at eight in the evening, two hours later than it does now.

frases.es: El ayuntamiento explica que la medida responde a las peticiones de estudiantes y trabajadores.
frases.en: The town council says the change responds to requests from students and workers.

frases.es: Los sábados, el horario seguirá siendo el mismo.
frases.en: On Saturdays, the opening hours will stay the same.

frases.es: La sala de lectura abrirá a las nueve y ofrecerá conexión a internet durante todo el horario ampliado.
frases.en: The reading room will open at nine and offer internet access throughout the extended opening hours.

frases.es: La noticia no especifica si habrá más personal en el edificio durante esas horas.
frases.en: The report does not specify whether more staff will be in the building during those hours.
